tagline: Energy delivery company serving seven million customers across four states
hero_kpi_rationale: Capital expenditures of $65.5 billion over 10 years (2026-2035) reflect CenterPoint Energy's major commitment to energy infrastructure to support anticipated demand growth of nearly 50% in its Houston Electric territory by 2029

risks.title: Regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations and changes in government laws and policies, which may impact its operations and financial results. The language used in the report is cautious and emphasizes the importance of these factors.

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt and faces credit risks, particularly due to financial market volatility. The report underscores the importance of debt management and credit risk mitigation.

risks.title: Operational risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces operational risks, particularly due to the complexity of its operations and dependence on suppliers and customers. The report emphasizes the importance of operational risk management.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks, particularly due to its dependence on information and communication technologies. The report underscores the importance of data protection and information systems security.

risks.title: Environmental risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces environmental risks, particularly due to the impact of its operations on the environment. The report emphasizes the importance of environmental risk management and carbon footprint reduction.

risks.title: Reputational risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces reputational risks, particularly due to stakeholder perceptions of its operations and performance. The report highlights the importance of reputation management and stakeholder communication.

risks.title: Market risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces market risks, particularly due to competition and market volatility. The report emphasizes the importance of market risk management and adaptation to business environment changes.

risks.title: Demand growth risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant uncertainty exists regarding the anticipated electric demand growth and the company's ability to capitalize on opportunities presented by these developments, particularly data centers and energy.
